observable: Thrombus formation rate (measured by histological analysis of explanted valves)
baseline: Current mechanical heart valve thrombus formation rate (± 20% standard deviation)
conditions: In vitro testing with whole blood, flow rates of 2-4 L/min, and a 30-day testing period
falsifier: No significant reduction in thrombus formation rate observed after 30 days of in vitro testing with whole blood

observable: Platelet adhesion rate (measured by fluorescence microscopy)
baseline: Current mechanical heart valve platelet adhesion rate (± 15% standard deviation)
conditions: In vitro testing with platelet-rich plasma, flow rates of 2-4 L/min, and a 2-hour testing period
falsifier: No significant reduction in platelet adhesion rate observed after 2 hours of in vitro testing with platelet-rich plasma
